findings.title: The hard-link exemption anchor resolves through <root>/node_modules, so a node_modules symlinked to a decoy inside the allow-list exempts hard links there.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:311-315 and :134. /node_modules/leak.txt and /decoy/leak.txt returned 200 with the outside file.
findings.consequence: Hard-link disclosure for anyone able to replace node_modules with a symlink.

findings.title: load() protects an enumerated list of query shapes; any other query falls through to Vite reading the file by name, which leaks under a swap race.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:457-474 reads = null fallback; Vite loadAndTransform readFile. GET /data/swap.ts?foo=bar under a toggler served the transformed secret module.
findings.consequence: The import-query race is not closed in general.

findings.title: The ?worker and ?worker&inline race cases cannot fail in dev, because the worker wrapper never contains the loaded bytes.
findings.evidence: Vite worker plugin transform in serve mode returns a wrapper computed from the id.
findings.consequence: Two of twenty race cases are not evidence.
